scope: One supplied account; only release 221 detail and its marketplace fully visited. Other release cards and own listing summaries were observed, not their behaviors.
unexplored: Incorrect/blank login and signed-out business actions
Search matching, pagination, genres, forum/blog and linked informational pages
Marketplace filter/sort application and no-results boundaries
Listing creation, form validation, deactivate/reactivate and editing
Cart removal, quantity ceiling, unavailable/inactive/sold listing handling
Empty/repeat/insufficient-stock checkout; other currencies; concurrent changes

rejection_evidence.reason: Attempt called empty-login actually submitted prefilled credentials and succeeded; it cannot verify blank-input rejection. Locator failures are not business-rule rejections.

competing_hypotheses.question: Does set-like membership generalize beyond release221?
competing_hypotheses.proposed_distinguishing_experiment: On a future allowed run, baseline another visible release, add, repeat, reopen list and release.

competing_hypotheses.question: Repeat membership may be a no-op, duplicate or toggle.
competing_hypotheses.proposed_distinguishing_experiment: Repeat one confirmed membership and reopen list and release.

evaluation_limits: No private tasks were supplied or consulted.
Predictions are forecasts, not independent task scores.
Snapshots and observed UI-caused responses bound all claims.
